# What the workshop repairs
- Bicycles of every size, from a balance bicycle of a child to a cargo bicycle with two wheels at the front.
- Wheels, from a buckled wheel of a city bicycle to the wheel of a racing bicycle that a car hit.
- Brakes of every kind, including the hydraulic brakes of a mountain bicycle and the drum brakes of a tandem.
- Gears, cables and shifters, with the chain and the cassette that the customer chooses from the catalogue.
- Lamps, bells, baskets and locks, fitted while the customer waits and tested before the bicycle leaves.
